campaign: Integrated validation: image/video bounded capability gains through shared code, faster processing and lower memory use
doctrine:
This worktree's sole live execution plan is docs/plan.json. Scope: validate and optimize existing image/video generation and declared conditioning/edit paths, and publish root media_report.md with actual images/clips, reproducible references, resource measurements and explicit limitations. Work exclusively in C:/Users/jeffm/image_video_gen on codex/image_video_gen; commit here. Base: master a5798b52. Master and other lanes retain their own plans, uncommitted work and stores. Do not merge or push without a later instruction. Do not run the unrelated master text, speech, training or whole-catalog campaigns. Local targeted fixes to shared runtime owners remain in scope when required for image/video correctness, efficiency or recovery; retain their affected regression checks. Coordinate conflicts before integrating other lanes' shared-owner changes.

Apply skill.md: capability freeze enforced by structure; preserve behavior, use derived values and justify shape/distribution/geometry assumptions. No model-specific optimizer tuning, arbitrary acceptance thresholds, fixed machine assumptions or duplicate runtime/report/scheduler owners. This is an inference/generation campaign; training, model acquisition and broad architecture changes need a demonstrated in-scope prerequisite rather than automatic expansion. Reference models and native implementations read-only; retain licenses and hashes.

All rows remain open until their exact acceptance succeeds and the gate records completion. The initial planning commit only defines the campaign and report outline. New test names in verify are planned acceptance implementations, not claims of existing tests: create them in the specified existing package before acquisition, exercise a failing counterexample, and use plan -setverify when a concrete selector changes. File guards and the gate's structured named-test evidence checks reject missing, zero-match and skipped acceptance. Do not pipe go test -list through a plain-text filter: planverify converts Go test output to JSON. Listings, skipped tests, report freshness and model activation do not prove quality. Report missing prerequisites as UNAVAILABLE and retain required obligations; no skipped or partial coverage becomes a pass. Verify commands run through the repository's shell/test owners with explicit worktree data-root configuration and appropriate device/browser lanes. Do not run every hardware suite merely to validate the planning document.

Use a private worktree evidence store and inherited immutable evidence only after identity checks. The inherited census_evidence identifies the fork's recorded baseline, not a new local census or current media inventory. Prepare and verify a supported snapshot before any write-capable recipe, compatibility, evaluation or gate command; do not hardlink writable store state to another worktree. Models may remain read-only at declared existing locations. Keep scratch in tmp/, durable measurements/lineage in OvergoDB, reviewable exports in docs/media_samples and the focused report at media_report.md. The generated docs/MEDIA_REPORT.md continues to represent the existing all-media report. Extend its existing generator for the requested focused view instead of maintaining an independent reporting system.

Reuse valid completed results across retries and unrelated changes. Group missing acquisitions by loaded model; acquire that model's required cases before unloading. Preserve original prompts, seeds, source protocols, quality criteria and result identities. Re-score retained compatible outputs without generation. Correctness, perceptual quality and performance are separate dispositions; a benchmark timing or a decodable image cannot substitute for the other checks. Freeze criteria before proposing an optimization, retain rejected/failed results, and adopt only when required quality and robustness hold and the specified efficiency comparison supports it.

Measure actual available RAM, VRAM, CPU, GPU, disk, driver/kernel and concurrent reservations before admission. Use existing shared/exclusive resource ownership. Derive execution size, measurement repeats and bounds from declared workload, capacity and observed variability; record operator ceilings and stop before unsupported resource use. Include acquisition, preparation, failed attempts, waits, verification, cleanup and publication in total cost. Never sum overlapping durations and label them elapsed wall. Preserve cumulative budgets and unfinished obligations after interruption. Host planning and evidence inspection do not reserve a GPU. No background experiment, external publication, large model download or new automatic schedule is implied by this planning task.

Execution order follows dependencies. Quality and resource requirements precede acquisitions; report preparation and per-model validation can progress independently where dependencies and resources permit. Optimization requires the affected baseline and lifecycle checks. Export and report joins reuse completed artifacts. Closeout depends on every retained row and cannot silently remove failed requirements. Future campaign changes commit through cmd/gate with the current plan step; preserve this lane's plan and the master's independent campaign during any later authorized integration.

Optimization priority: reduce end-to-end generation time, CPU/GPU memory consumption and avoidable transfers while consolidating common implementation responsibilities. Start from existing graphruntime.ResidentSession, cuda/executor retained outputs and buffer pools, cuda/device and driver ownership, devicemath, media codecs and recipe integration. Map real callers and their contracts before extracting common code. Share behavior with demonstrated equivalent semantics; keep model-specific mathematics and causal/sampling rules in declared programs and policies. Migrate at least two real consumers when claiming shared-component consolidation, delete displaced paths, and report both removed and added code. A facade around duplicate implementations is not completion. Do not build a universal media engine, independent allocator, transfer queue, scheduler or report framework.

Avoid a catalog-wide prerequisite for the first improvement. Use retained evidence and a small representative baseline cohort selected from actual shared callers. Capture profiling data, correctness, resource use and representative samples in the same necessary generation runs. Inspect source ownership and retained measurements before GPU work. Run the first baseline-to-candidate comparison without waiting for unrelated model validation or final report formatting. Treat each acceptance as a dependency predicate rather than a requirement to repeat acquisition. Reuse a representative cohort result in the corresponding full model bundle. Full validation and final publication still cover the frozen required denominator.

For each candidate record affected consumers and input identities, anticipated transfer/allocation/compute savings, required quality and lifecycle checks, and the cost of analysis, implementation verification and acquisition. Prioritize eliminating unnecessary copies, duplicated preparation and oversized live allocations before overlapping transfers or adding fusion. Keep independent memory, transfer and processing candidates separately measurable; serialize edits that touch the same owner, and compare their combination before adoption. Report tradeoffs explicitly: lower latency may increase retained VRAM, and lower peak memory may increase transfers or recomputation. Adopt only within the frozen acceptance limits and actual compute budget. No arbitrary speedup percentage, memory fraction or repeat count is required.

Distinguish compile-time code coupling from runtime effects when selecting checks for shared changes. Use the gate's existing dependency and receipt owners; unresolved effects retain required checks. Do not duplicate master's ongoing coupling-analysis or test-deadline work in this lane. Bind tests and measurements to the exact changed component and all affected consumers. Keep pure host checks independent of hardware acquisitions, and reuse compatible correctness evidence separately from timing measurements. Device/browser acceptance must run through its existing lane; the compatibility tests named here join stored records and exercise corruption/missing-result counterexamples. They do not replace the owning component's tests. Extend an existing acceptance file where appropriate and update plan -setverify; the planned filenames do not mandate a separate file per row.

Inherited master plan identities remain in this document because the existing completion authority forbids removing unfinished rows. Previously unassigned inherited items are assigned to master in this worktree; operator ownership remains unchanged. The image_video_gen lane dispatches only its media rows. Its closeout is media-closeout/closeout. The inherited campaign-closeout also retains a dependency on that media closeout, preserving the global graph without admitting unrelated master work here. items.title: Refactor shared generation components and reduce compute, memory, and transfer cost

steps.title: Reduce repeated preparation, conversions, and synchronization on the measured critical path
steps.rationale: Target the remaining measured critical path through existing shared operations. Reuse valid compiled topology, prompt/conditioning preparation and decode configuration; eliminate redundant CPU serialization, full tensor scans, repeated format conversions and unnecessary synchronization before considering new fused kernels. Use existing CUDA/devicemath operations and preserve operation order where references require it. Fuse or batch only when real compatible callers and measured launch/processing cost justify it, and derive the choice from geometry and capacity. Overlap independent preparation, execution or export only with explicit dependency and resource ownership; preserve error/cancellation and avoid contaminating exclusive measurements. Compare end-to-end cold/warm latency and throughput with preparation and final export included, not only a kernel microbenchmark. Keep quality, memory and transfer constraints fixed; record a relevant ablation and every intentional numerical difference against the accepted tolerance. Use the shared baseline and avoid duplicating the transfer/memory candidates' experiments; serialize conflicting edits and retain independent comparisons for later combination.

steps.title: Validate combined changes, all affected consumers, and constrained compute behavior
steps.rationale: Join accepted refactoring, transfer, memory and processing changes into the current source and test their interaction on the frozen affected consumers. Reuse unaffected full model bundles; recheck only the quality/lifecycle assertions invalidated by shared-owner changes. A combined improvement must preserve all required correctness, visual/temporal quality, API behavior and resource constraints, even when each isolated ablation passed. Record baseline-to-combined latency, throughput, peak/retained host/device memory, transfer bytes/calls, synchronization and total experiment cost, with observed variability. Exercise current available and supported constrained RAM/VRAM/CPU/GPU profiles, repeated variable-shape generation, contention, waiting cancellation and resource release. Derive supported execution plans from actual capacity; do not silently reduce resolution, frames, sampling steps or precision to obtain a pass. Keep unsuitable candidates rejected with their evidence. An absent fitting execution plan remains an explicit prerequisite, not a successful fallback. Do not require unrelated model reacquisition or attribute concurrent work to an optimization.

Publish through existing gate cost/evidence owners. Include merge snapshot preparation: this intake copies a source store with 117099 blobs; measure copying, syncing and replay before choosing immutable snapshot reuse or incremental backup. Preserve verified store ancestry and crash integrity. No recurring full benchmark merely to validate gate savings. Adoption may proceed independently of the modality report; broader batching still retains its recovery and promotion prerequisites. Prioritize ordinary documentation and plan edits: target seconds-scale publication and measure the ratio against the 1006.894-second documentation incident; 100x is an operator optimization target, not permission to omit required checks or a claimed result. Separate prose/assets from embedded inputs, fixtures, generated contracts and executable policy. Remove the recurring requirement to edit Go task-ID lists for routine plan additions while retaining substantive campaign constraints. Resolve non-Go consumer ownership before narrowing lanes; file extensions alone cannot authorize exclusion. Include preparation and finalization in the comparison. Make browser acceptance granular through the existing webui-lane -run selector: bind each journey to its component/route, shared shell, JavaScript/CSS dependencies and consumed HTTP contracts. Shared authentication, session and protocol changes widen to their consumers; unresolved reach retains the complete lane. Reuse independent scenario receipts across sibling failure and restart. Bind each selector to its owning package and refuse missing, skipped or zero-match targets. Prepare browser/server/model/GPU resources only for selected journeys that consume them. No second UI scheduler, policy list or receipt authority. Compare selected and full runs with seeded component, navigation and authentication regressions before adoption. Eliminate routine report-Markdown regeneration as a source of unrelated gate invalidation: consume existing typed report identities, distinguish a requested rendered view from authoritative state, and demonstrate unchanged evidence remains reusable. Landed documentation measurement: 7367a3f8 completed the README and plan publication gate in 87.434 seconds, versus 153.329 seconds for 7589ed77. Runtime package, GPU and browser executions were all zero; modern-Go 17.901 seconds, bound acceptance 7.623 seconds, document checks 6.577 seconds and finalization 12.213 seconds. No competing analysis probes were run by this session during the measurement. This improves elapsed cost but does not meet the seconds-scale target. steps.rationale:
Existing checkpoint memo, independent package receipts, transaction recovery, shared GPU admission, input preflight, candidate isolation and terminal-obligation owners are lower bounds, not features to rebuild. Retain every existing verifier, checkpoint and escalation obligation. The new evidence-commit-recovery prerequisite owns immediate reliability repair; this row owns later policy integration. Campaign-wide batch promotion retains its recovery and modality-report prerequisites. Independently proven input selection and correctness-evidence reuse may land through validation-gate-selection/measured-adoption before that report, with the same required outcomes and outstanding obligations. Do not make the completed modality campaign a prerequisite for reducing the verified cost of completing it.

Selection must follow actual compiled dependencies, fixtures, runtime files, subprocesses, renames/deletions, build tags, toolchain, device mode and resolved environment. Unknown reach broadens verification, including required fixture/device tests; it does not justify a short-only downgrade. Before adopting Hatchet classification, add counterexamples for os.Args[1], reassignment and shadowing, aliased os/exec imports, caller-supplied paths, indirect launchers, command argument construction, embedded inputs and repository-level fixtures. Use binding-aware analysis or conservative fallback; textual identifier names, one safe assignment, file extensions and package-wide caller annotations cannot establish independence. Shadow-compare the complete historical/injected-failure matrix against the current full gate: no omitted required checks, missed seeded regression or stale receipt. Policy changes cannot validate themselves using their proposed reduced scope.

Persist each terminal package success independently as it finishes, even if a sibling fails, skips or is killed. Reuse requires exact input/environment/contract identities; a failed write retries receipt publication, not acquisition. Retain cumulative obligations across kill/restart, replan, scope expansion and branch changes. Never credit skipped, unavailable, unfinished or zero-match tests; acquire required fixtures and distinguish explicit unsupported-platform exclusions. Scratch retry files remain projections of OvergoDB authority. Include interrupted replacement of gate_cache.json and independent successful packages beside failed/unavailable siblings.

Prepare mechanical derived authorities before freezing the candidate, then run cheap deterministic refusals before expensive acceptance and packages. Bind both baseline and published census to the staged candidate. Preserve the same resolved dataset roots between acceptance and package tests. Mechanical preparation may regenerate manifests/censuses from existing reviewed policy; it cannot change semantic literal exceptions, floors or adjudication. Recompute candidate identity after preparation; reject later drift. Keep preflight read-only and nonpromoting. Repeat deterministic evidence assertions without silently repeating independent model acquisition; preserve compound-command coverage and every required repeat.

Consolidate resource and supervision policy through existing processcontrol, driver and gate owners. Prove CPU work holds no GPU lease; correctness users coexist; an exclusive measurement child is never blocked by an ancestor's shared lease; publication holds only its write transaction; process/child death releases ownership. Never infer abandonment from heartbeat age or process names. Preserve physical identity across stores/worktrees, bounded waiting, cancellation causes and task-completion resource output. No second package-ownership list, wait loop, launcher or recovery state machine.

Only after these proofs, integrate implemented/checkpointed, verified and promoted transitions through the existing gate. Test refusal with outstanding checks; exact source/index/HEAD and immutable lineage; restart/replan without orphaned obligations; mandatory escalation; final full integration; elapsed-only flush with no new checkpoint; trailing obligations; exact boundaries and empty/negative/overflow/pre-origin refusal. Keep BatchFlush.Advance as the transition owner; no duplicate accumulator or reset authority. Privatize gate-only cost helpers and remove displaced callers atomically. Retain reviewed exclusions from prior lane intakes; no open lane plan or previously refused policy is implicitly imported.

Measure cold and resumed runs on the same representative change matrix, including an evidence-only E4B selection, a test change, fixture/runtime input change, kernel and gate-policy change. Report full wall, wait, acquisition, checks, publication, repeated loads, package reuse, outstanding obligations and operator interventions; do not equate summed phase time with elapsed savings. Require reduced repeated work/intervention with identical regression detection; otherwise keep the old policy. The E4B 935.2-second gate executed 234 packages with zero package reuse after a 97.1-second database-lock failure: use that incident to drive a controlled counterexample, not a universal performance threshold.

After Hatchet intake, validation-gate-selection owns immediate call-reach, shared scope and measured adoption. Reuse its receipts and tests here; do not reimplement that work. The modality-report prerequisite applies to broad batch promotion, not to the independent selector improvements.
